messages:
paul: FYI the examples repo CI started failing because it links into docs anchors that changed after the MDX migration. external refs from examples -> docs are 404ing.

ci-bot: build: examples/ci: linkcheck failed (exit 2). failing targets: docs.redwood/inference/getting-started#quickstart-and-setup and docs.redwood/inference/sdk#python-setup. full log: https://ci.redwood/example/9001 :warning:

anya: dang, cross-repo links are rough. are those anchors missing in the docs side now or were the example links wrong?

paul: looks like the docs slugifier collapsed some punctuation and removed snippet titles. examples was referencing `#quickstart-and-setup` and `#python-setup` which no longer exist. the docs repo has new slugs like `#quickstart` and `#python-client-setup`.

sophie: we should treat cross-repo links as a first-class contract. quick options: 1) add explicit ids in docs to match what examples expects, 2) update examples to new slugs (but that requires a coordinated deploy), 3) add redirect/legacy anchor map on the docs site so external repos keep working.

paul: i prefer option 3 for partner-friendly behavior + option 1 for high-traffic anchors. avoid touching too many repos at once.

anya: agree. i'll open a small docs PR that adds explicit ids for the anchors referenced by examples and also add a `legacy_anchors.json` with mappings for the handful of external anchors we know about.

paul: also let's add a pre-commit docs lint to the docs repo so new PRs must include explicit ids when headings contain inline code, emoji, or parentheses. saves future link churn. could be a simple grep in pre-commit that warns if a heading with backticks or emoji doesn't have `{#...}`.

sophie: i prototyped a tiny hook `hooks/check_heading_ids.sh` that uses sed + grep to find headings with code/emoji and checks for `{#`. snippet:
```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
git diff --name-only --cached | grep -E '\.mdx?$' | while read f; do
  if grep -n "^#+ .*\`.*\|\p{Emoji}" "$f" >/dev/null; then
    if ! grep -n "\{#[-a-z0-9]+\}" "$f" >/dev/null; then
      echo "Missing explicit id in $f for heading with code/emoji"
      exit 1
    fi
  fi
done
```
(uses perl-regex in grep on CI image)

ci-bot: note: pre-commit hooks run in CI only if configured in .pre-commit-config.yaml. suggestion: add a docs-lint job to our docs pipeline. :info:

anya: thanks. i'll add the hook to `.pre-commit-config.yaml` and include docs in CONTRIBUTING.md with a short guideline: "Add `{#your-id}` for headings with code/emoji/paren when they're linked from other repos."

paul: for the immediate fix i filed examples PR to accept the redirects fallback, but docs PR should land first. link to both PRs in the issue so releases can coordinate.

sophie: i'll add a simple CI annotator that parses mkdocs/docusaurus linkcheck output and posts a comment with suggested `{#...}` patches. the annotator will run on docs PRs and on cross-repo link failure events. prototype cmd i used locally: 
```
python -c "import re,sys;print('\n'.join(set(re.findall(r'([^ ]+)#([^ ]+)', sys.stdin.read()))))" < linkcheck.log
```
it prints file+fragment pairs we can turn into suggestions.

ci-bot: queued: docs/mkdocs linkcheck for PR 4720 (includes explicit ids + legacy_anchors.json).

anya: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4720  adds 6 explicit ids, legacy_anchors.json with 4 mappings, pre-commit hook and CONTRIBUTING blurb. includes `scripts/ci_anchor_annotator.py` that posts suggested fixes.

paul: i updated the examples PR to use the legacy variants as a temporary fallback and added a note to update after docs stable.

sophie: follow-up: create an integration test in examples CI that verifies external links into docs before merging major changes to docs. we can curl anchor URLs and assert 200s. small bash check: 
```
for u in $(cat anchors.txt); do
  status=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "$u")
  test "$status" = "200" || { echo "bad anchor: $u"; exit 1; }
done
```
keeps cross-repo contracts healthy.

ci-bot: PR 4720 linkcheck passed; ready to merge. :white_check_mark:

(last) anya: merged and deployed to staging. examples CI green after consuming legacy anchors. created follow-up issue to tighten the pre-commit regex and add the annotator to CI for automatic PR comments: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/256. thanks all! :rocket:
